scientific_integrity: An exact analytic Schur factorization proves the stated spectral-radius classification; executable symbolic and sample-spectrum checks provide supplementary reproducibility. Publication priority may require independent literature checking.
scientific_limitations: Exact constant equal-step, extrapolation-one, homogeneous two-dimensional quadratic iteration with a planar rotational surrogate adjoint. No claim for nonlinear functions, unequal steps, nonorthogonal mismatches, finite precision, or forced problems. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact angular stability frontier of a planar mismatched primal–dual iteration
